clips.name: ball_roll_left
clips.notes: ball roll from standing: right sole rolls the ball 0.6 m to his left, support-foot hop, exit to the left-forward

clips.name: ball_roll_right
clips.notes: ball roll from standing: right sole rolls the ball 0.6 m to his left, support-foot hop, exit to the left-forward

clips.name: ball_roll_left_run
clips.notes: ball roll at 1.5 m/s: right sole rolls the ball 0.75 m to his left while all travel 0.6 m forward, support-foot crossover hop

clips.name: ball_roll_right_run
clips.notes: ball roll at 1.5 m/s: right sole rolls the ball 0.75 m to his left while all travel 0.6 m forward, support-foot crossover hop

clips.name: drag_back_right
clips.notes: drag-back from standing: right sole pulls the ball 0.65 m back to under the body, support-foot hop back, hips open, neutral exit

clips.name: drag_back_left
clips.notes: drag-back from standing: right sole pulls the ball 0.65 m back to under the body, support-foot hop back, hips open, neutral exit

clips.name: drag_back_right_run
clips.notes: drag-back braking from 3 m/s: hard plant, sole stops the ball and pulls it 0.65 m back under him, rock back, neutral exit

clips.name: drag_back_left_run
